cutoff: Monotone stock sessions; an observed or known-at date after D is rejected. Facts are applied on their recorded known-at session, never retroactively. Formal D0 and earlier exports are immutable.

pinned_sources.cohort_scope: 002865.SZ original 344 signal dates; 2316 native stock sessions from listing through 2026-11-06

proof_gate.accepted_proof: Explicit registered source_id and exact SHA-256, unique fact_id, target identity, observed date and immutable known date. Historical market/RAW/proxy/desk inputs do not have this authority. Synthetic sources in unit tests exercise transitions separately.
proof_gate.chronology: All transitions use only ordered evidence observed by D. A later/superseding mother or repair cannot rewrite identity or revive a failed chain. Within one day establish prerequisite facts before evidence-specific event decisions; explicit invalidation precedes same-day formal promotion.
proof_gate.dispatch: Evaluate all independent same-known-day candidate IDs before choosing representative fields. Aggregate every triggering method and identify each event/proof with observed date and decision/known date. An incumbent WATCH cannot hide another ID that triggers.

status_semantics.FORMAL: all identity-specific causally sourced prerequisites and no terminal failure
status_semantics.WATCH: source-confirmed chain plus explicitly incomplete or pending prerequisite
status_semantics.UNKNOWN: source evidence insufficient; absence of proof is not affirmative evidence
status_semantics.INVALIDATED: explicit sourced sticky chain failure, or sourced next-session B2 false break for future derivation only

raw.b2_oral: UNKNOWN; original course proof not recovered
raw.b2_F03: ANY(J<13 at D-2,D-1,D) AND V_D>1.25*MEAN(V_D_MINUS_4..V_D_MINUS_1) AND PCT_D>4 AND J_D<70 AND W_D>Y_D
raw.independence: RAW predicates have no union; literal thresholds are inherited unchanged. F02 is B1 RAW and cannot substitute for a B2 track or parent.

b1.mother: Explicit sourced jointly bullish attack and buildup on observed bullish C>O bar; immutable mother event ID, mother event date, support ID, fail level and originating source. S1_RAW, low J, non-bullish geometry and provisional ACT067D numeric proxies never create a mother.
b1.formal: Within the same living mother, independently confirmed post-parent pullback, genuine support and supply digestion, plus a separately sourced B1_CONFIRM on the observed D. Missing prerequisite is UNKNOWN; explicit false is WATCH or ineligible. No time expiry; a chain may persist beyond day 16.
b1.terminal: Explicit MOTHER_FAILURE sets the earliest known invalidation and source forever for that mother; later support/recovery on old ID stays invalidated. A new chain requires separately sourced fresh mother ID. Price comparison alone does not establish effective break.

b2.D0: Independently sourced candidate ID bound to its own stable base ID. Independent pullback/base and supply-digestion observed strictly before D0, plus sourced true bullish launch and actual departure on D0 and actual C>O. No B1 Formal or attack/buildup mother prerequisite; a mother may be supplied as an optional lineage reference. A failed explicitly linked mother blocks promotion/derivation of that linked launch. Sourced downtrend rebound or observed C<=O fails. With no sourced candidate the day gets only a market shape observation and UNKNOWN or necessary-condition FALSE, never a D0 event.
b2.sticky: Original D0 state sealed at its first decision. A sourced false breakout on the very next observed stock session blocks derived retests only from its known date onward. Original D0 remains unchanged even when break sourced later. A retest needs its own proof, a sealed positive earlier D0, no failure of any explicitly linked mother and no then-known false break.

continuation.path: STRONG_CONTINUATION distinct from B1/B2. Confirmed continuation binds a unique continuation ID to the source-bound context mother. Independently sourced continuation-support failure downgrades only that continuation and preserves separate routes. An invalidated mother cannot supply another formal continuation. Failing continuation never auto-becomes B1. B3 is HYPOTHESIS_ONLY; 5-day line is example only.

m25.repair: Separate immutable repair ID, original mother/root once valid before the first documented damage in its lineage, original support/fail level, lost structure ID, damage D and optional prior repair ID. A fresh linked repair with distinct D/T/C can refer to the same historically valid original root, preserving the prior episode and original failure provenance even if no longer live. This does not reactivate any old chain. Source-bound damage preserves its own identity even when root evidence is unavailable; missing root cannot qualify.
m25.order: D_DAMAGE<T_YELLOW_TEST<C_REBUILD_CONFIRM strictly by observed stock dates. T and C target same repair ID. Distinct newer sourced D after T invalidates the old repair and is independently tracked. Before T, explicit invalidation or unproved outcomes do not overwrite identity.
m25.C: C requires recovery of original root AND prior lost structure using explicitly matching identities, plus independent risk-clearance proof. Known not-reclaimed is WATCH; unbound risk/root/price is UNKNOWN. If all are independently confirmed then eligible FORMAL, without resurrecting original B1 or any old repair.
m25.drawdown: REPORTING_ONLY. 15%–20% descriptive; no arm, filter, condition, or state transition depends on the reported drawdown.
m25.late_completion: A C historically lacking same-observation-day complete recovery and risk stays non-actionable even if the last proof arrives later. Record WATCH plus LATE_PROOF_NON_ACTIONABLE (without a formal trigger) when later complete. A distinct subsequently observed C on the same still-valid repair can trigger on that C only with complete known-at proof. A documented damage after observed T invalidates the repair once both proofs are known, with no backdated result.

case_oracle: case_binding.json binds 7 dates from earlier blind lock by hash. Conditional user case semantics are separate from historical observed/provisional context and from ACT-069A actual states. A03 has no frozen case assertion, A09 actual candle shape is bullish and downtrend rebound remains unbound. A12 prior recorded D proxy alone does not establish after-T damage.
chart_eligibility: Only D on which at least one sourced method emits TRUE formal trigger after all known-at checks. No chart for RAW, observational, WATCH, UNKNOWN, invalidated or ineligible signals. If zero, ZIP root MANIFEST_SHA256.json only and PDF neutral zero selection page with no chart panels and zero post-D reads. If positive, blind left geometry is bound at D and right exact D+1..D+15 only in separate user atlas, pale gray, axes locked at <=D with exact phrase D后仅目视复盘区 / 严禁入引擎.
